notes: Pe07d4686f0 G4. Printed: 'Deathtouch (Any amount of damage this deals to a creature is enough to destroy it.)' Feral Abomination (5/5) attacks and seat 1's 0/8 wall blocks it. Five damage is not lethal to an 0/8 without deathtouch, so the wall dying shows the keyword (CR 702.2b, 704.5h). The Abomination takes nothing and no damage reaches seat 1.
